message.content:
**Fastest typical route (as of 2026)**  
> **Distance:** ~215 mi (≈346 km)  
> **Estimated travel time:** 3 h 30 min – 4 h (traffic‑dependent)

1. **Start in New York City** – get onto **I‑95 N** (NY‑95) from the city’s highway system.  
2. **Continue on I‑95 N** through the Bronx, into Connecticut.  
3. **Near Stamford, CT** – stay on I‑95 N; it will take you past Bridgeport, New Haven, and Hartford.  
4. **Approach Worcester, MA** – I‑95 N merges with I‑84 W briefly, then continues north.  
5. **Near Worcester** – I‑95 N turns into **I‑90 E (Massachusetts Turnpike)**.  
6. **Follow I‑90 E** straight into Boston, exiting at the **Boston‑Cambridge** area.

> **Why this route?**  
> - It’s the most direct interstate path.  
> - I‑95 N is a major corridor with high‑capacity lanes and fewer exits than alternative routes.  
> - The I‑90 E turn near Worcester keeps you on a single interstate until the destination.

---

### Quick Tips

| Situation | Recommended Action |
|-----------|--------------------|
| **Heavy weekday morning traffic** | Leave NYC earlier (e.g., 5 am) or use a navigation app (Google Maps, Waze) for real‑time detours. |
| **Avoid tolls** | Stick to I‑95 N; the only toll on this segment is the **Massachusetts Turnpike (I‑90 E)**, but it’s unavoidable if you want the fastest route. |
| **Scenic detour** | Take **I‑84 W** from Stamford to Hartford, then **I‑91 N** to Worcester, and finally **I‑90 E**. This adds ~30 mi but offers more scenic views. |

---

### Navigation Links

- **Google Maps**: [NYC → Boston](https://www.google.com/maps/dir/New+York,+NY/Boston,+MA/)
- **Waze**: [NYC → Boston](https://waze.com/ul?ll=42.3601,-71.0589&navigate=yes&zoom=10)

*(Links open in your browser; they’ll give you live traffic updates and the best current route.)*

Enjoy your trip! 🚗💨
